digest.component_or_area: store, reducer, graph and snapshot subsystems
propositions: Comment triage cannot recover sufficient lines from size-pressured files event_append.py (791/800 lines) and _processors.py (777/800 lines) because their comments encode replay-compat justifications; real refactoring seams are helper functions and migration blocks out of scope.

Verified-stale comments must be corrected in place where their referents remain live: gitutil.py module imports claim is false, llm_format.py header path and key enumeration are obsolete, and hlc.py release-bump claim is stale by four schema versions.

reducer/_version.py changelog (39-66 lines) and docs/event-schema.md both hold wire-format changelog in partial/stale state; canonical home must be completed with v4/v5 entries before code copy is collapsed to a citation.
The four SNAPSHOT-restore migration guards in _processors.py:719-774 are highest-risk and must not be relocated, as their rationale makes live guards distinguishable from dead defensive code.
graph/_graph.py:250-254 duplicates the same sentence as both a noqa pragma and a block comment; pragma must stay, block comment must be deleted.
A do_not_move list must be recorded in .joe-janitor/tools.md before edits land, capturing all KEEP and DO_NOT_MOVE comment units across the scope with their paths and reasons.
